name: ConfEviSurrogate
aliases: Conformal CNN Surrogate with Normal Inverse-Gamma Head
definition: Addresses the lack of calibrated uncertainty bounds in CNN surrogates by replacing the standard output layer with a four-parameter Normal Inverse-Gamma head.
summary: ConfEviSurrogate is a CNN surrogate for volume data that uses a Normal Inverse-Gamma head and conformal prediction to provide calibrated uncertainty bounds with finite-sample coverage guarantees.
